fw.allInstances: Applies to all instances in the VPC

empty.reason: Every VPC has at least default rules, so an empty list almost certainly means collection failed — not that there are no rules. Check the cloud credential and whether the service account has compute.viewer.
empty.title: No firewall rules retrieved

fw.error: Firewall rules could not be loaded
fw.searchPlaceholder: Search rule name, allowed ports or source ranges

empty.noIssuesReason: Among the bindings collected, no overly broad roles such as owner/editor and no allUsers grants were found. ⚠️ This holds only for the projects actually collected — switch to "All bindings" to confirm the projects you care about are covered.
empty.reason: Every GCP project has at least one binding, so this means collection has not succeeded — not that there is no risk. Check the cloud credential and whether the service account has roles/iam.securityReviewer.
empty.title: No IAM bindings retrieved

iam.error: The permission audit could not be loaded

filter.noDataToFilter: No IAM bindings collected yet, so there is nothing to filter. Follow the note below to get collection working first

empty.reason: Usually the cloud account is not connected yet, or the credential lacks permission to read network resources. This does not mean you have no static IPs — reserved but unattached addresses keep billing, so check "Idle only" once connected.
empty.title: No IP addresses retrieved

ips.error: The IP inventory could not be loaded
ips.gkeNameHint: This is an internal name GKE generates for forwarding rules / backend services, not a name you chose. To find which service it belongs to, look up this IP under Clusters → Services & ingress, or search the name in the GCP load balancing console.
